definition_used: Complaints about one or more companies/institutions in addition to concerns about the original article. RW may also use this reason for cases in which something about one or more companies/institutions is called into question following any notice, i.e., when complaints escalate to being entirely company/institution-based.
caution: The reason focuses on complaints about companies/institutions, which may relate to research conduct but does not directly assert issues with research content, authorship, or editorial processes. It primarily signals post-publication scrutiny involving institutional actors.
semantic_rationale: Complaints about companies/institutions imply external or institutional investigation processes, aligning with post-publication oversight. The definition does not specify reliability of research content, authorship, or editorial governance, so only the oversight category is assigned broadly.
